walkableNote: THE FLOOR IN FRONT OF EVERYTHING. The door's foot is at y 740, the chair's at 735, the desk's at 710 and the case's at 700; the band starts at 745, in front of them all, and runs the room's width short of the walls.

scaling.note: ROOM 8'S DEPTH, FROM THE DESK. Operation 2 re-framed the master: the clerk's desk, 185 tall in the master, is 240 here, which makes the man the master painted beside it about 530 with his feet at y 792. Along Room 7's slope (0.69 per row), next door: 497 at the band's far edge, 570 at its near.

entrances.note: Through the archive door from the registrar's, at left.
Anything else arrives by the door.

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees (ruling 32). THE DUST is the one shelf at chest height wiped clean by years of reaching; CLAIM ONE'S BOX (the brass corner) and THE TIMESHEET (the string-tied bundles) stand on it and win by area. THE COUNTY SEAL and THE EXECUTORS' LEDGER lie on THE CLERK'S DESK and win the same way; THE FILING LADDER wins over THE STACKS; THE BARRED WINDOW over THE DAMP CORNER below it. THE LAMP BRACKET carries the scorch above it.

lamps.note: THE LAMP BRACKET (doc 08: 'the lamp lives in a bracket by the door, and the deep stacks stay dark'). The room's only light, a slow, low breath; it never signals anything (invariant 9).

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. Every object here is looked at on a bare click. The floor is not a hotspot.

occlusion.note: NO PLANE MASKS THAT CAN REACH HIM: the walk band is in front of every piece of furniture.
